hooks.command: export MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1; docker exec tk-ruby true 2>/dev/null || exit 0; a=$(find app lib config db spec -name '*.rb' -newermt '-20 seconds' -printf '%p ' 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$a" ] && exit 0; docker cp . tk-ruby:/app >/dev/null 2>&1; o=$(docker exec tk-ruby bash -c "cd /app && bundle lock --add-platform x86_64-linux >/dev/null 2>&1 && bundle exec rubocop --format simple --force-exclusion $a" 2>&1); s=$?; [ $s -eq 0 ] && exit 0; echo "$o" | grep -vE 'extension supports plugin|plugin_migration_guide' >&2; exit 2
